item.title: Version 1.6.12
item.changes: With the Move tool, Option-arrow duplicates the layer and moves the copy 1 px (Option-Shift-arrow moves it 10 px) Select a shape with the Shape tool to change its fill, stroke and corner radius, or a line's color, width, style and cap Rectangles and ellipses can have a stroke Fill with Foreground or Background recolors a shape and keeps it editable A shape drawn above a group of clipped layers now shows in full while you drag it out
